nodes.title: Welcome to Flogic
nodes.subtitle: Flow + logic. Right-click anywhere on the board to add a node, then drag from the dots on its sides to connect ideas.

blocks.text: Every node has a + in its corner. Use it to add text, highlights, categories, scenarios, checklists, images and sources.

blocks.label: Tip
blocks.text: Double-click any text to edit it.

blocks.label: Move things
blocks.text: Grab the 6-dot handle beside a block to reorder it, drop it into another node, or pull it onto the board.

blocks.label: Conclusion
blocks.text: Everything snaps to the grid so the board stays tidy. Hold Ctrl to place freely.
Scenarios fold up so a node stays compact. Open one to see how it plays out.

steps.label: First
steps.text: You sketch it on the board.

steps.label: Then
steps.text: Connections show how each part leads to the next.

steps.label: Result
steps.text: The argument reads top to bottom.

steps.label: You answer
steps.text: Add a sub-note with the missing link and a source.

items.text: Drag on empty space to box-select
Right-click empty space to add a node

blocks.text: Attach references so anyone reading can check them.
Visitors see the published board, read-only. Only you can edit, after connecting GitHub in Settings.
